name: Manufacturing Engineering
summary: Manufacturing Engineering designs and improves the processes and systems used to make products. Students learn production technologies, automation, and quality control.
description: Manufacturing Engineering majors study materials and manufacturing processes such as machining, casting, welding, molding, and additive manufacturing, along with CAD/CAM, CNC programming, robotics and automation, quality engineering, and production systems. They learn Lean manufacturing, statistical process control, and how to design products for efficient manufacture. Hands-on labs use industrial equipment. Graduates work in automotive, aerospace, electronics, medical device, and consumer goods manufacturing, where they improve efficiency, quality, and safety on the factory floor.
